entries.zh: 渡口，津渡（河流可涉渡之处）
entries.notes: L 栏作「Passage derio S.」有残损，义据汉字「津」与西语 pasaje de río 定。

entries.zh: 辮带，装饰用编带（花边、穗带）

entries.notes: H 栏「炭」与音写 Poū gāur 不合，L 栏 natural, y moral 亦不可解，无法定夺。

entries.en: to pass swiftly, to go past quickly
entries.notes: H 栏仅录「迅」，音写 sĭn pōu 多一音节（疑为「步」），义据 L 栏 pasar presto 定。

entries.zh: 转手（把东西从一人手中转到另一人，或给或借）
entries.en: to pass from hand to hand (giving or lending)
entries.notes: 音写零乱，R 栏编者注 dar bueltas，义据 L 栏「pasar de una mano a otra, dando o prestando」定。

entries.en: to pass through a hole, as thread through a needle
to cross a river by boat, to ferry across
to soak through (sweat through a garment)
entries.notes: H 栏「時」与音写入声 chy 不合，疑为「漬」之误录，义据 L 栏 pasar el sudor la vestidura 定。

entries.zh: 转移（把东西从一处移到另一处）
entries.en: to transfer something from one place to another
entries.notes: H 栏「貰」（租赁）与 L 栏不合，音写 ûan 疑为「換」，仅据 L 栏姑定。

entries.en: to pierce a hole; to pass through an opening

entries.zh: 度日，消磨（时光）；经历岁月
entries.en: to pass time, to spend time
entries.notes: H 栏「歷」带[疑]，音写 láy lāc 两音节与单字不合，义据 L 栏 pasar el tiempo 定。

entries.en: to leak, to seep (of a vessel)
entries.notes: H 栏「紋」与 L 栏 pasarse como la vasija 不合，音写 cã būn 亦难解，仅据 L 栏姑定。

entries.zh: 涉水过河（据西语词头）；〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to ford the river; [original damaged, gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 音写 liâu 后标[残]，H 栏「廖」于义无取，仅西语词头 vado 可据。

entries.en: to pass in peace, to get through safely
entries.notes: L 栏后半 niano ni perdio 不可解，义据 H 栏「平過」与前半 paso en paz 定。

entries.en: to pass, to go across; to come over
entries.notes: M 栏污损（T99），R 栏 coē lāy viniendo 可读作「過來」，与 H 栏「過」互证。
